title: Ordering at a cafe
situation: You order a drink at a coffee shop counter.

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: Welcome. Would you like to order?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Yes, one americano please.

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: Hot one or cold one?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Iced please.

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: What size would you like?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I will go with the small one.

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: For here or to go?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: To go. How much is it?

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: It is four thousand five hundred won.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Here is my card. Thank you.

tip: Cafes always ask 따뜻한 거 (hot) or 아이스 (iced), so decide before you reach the counter.

title: Ordering and paying at a restaurant
situation: You order food at a casual restaurant and pay at the end.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: How many people?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Two people.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Sit over here. And your order?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: One bibimbap and one kimchi stew please.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Is spicy food okay for you?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Yes, it is fine. Some water too please.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Sure, please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Excuse me, I will pay now.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: It is fifteen thousand won in total.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I will pay by card. Thank you for the meal.

tip: Say 저기요 to call staff, and pay at the counter or table when you are ready, since tipping is not expected in Korea.

title: Buying items at a convenience store
situation: You buy a few items at a convenience store counter.

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: Welcome.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Two of these please.

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: Do you need a bag?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Yes, one please.

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: The bag is one hundred won.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: That is fine. How much is it all together?

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: It is three thousand two hundred won.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I will pay in cash.

lines.speaker: 점원
lines.en: Here is eight hundred won change.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Okay, thank you.

tip: Plastic bags usually cost extra in Korea, so staff will ask 봉투 필요하세요 before charging you.
